name: asuma_idle
desc: Pixel art game sprite, side view, full body from horns to feet, standing idle pose facing left in three-quarter view. A short but very muscular anthro dragon-wolf man: dark charcoal grey fur, spiky fluffy cheek fur and messy hair fringe, large pointed ears with dark inner ear and small silver ring piercings, two glowing light-blue spiral horns, light blue eyes with a half-lidded cocky look, short broad snout, small white fang, faint confident smirk with mouth closed, black collar with a silver buckle, broad shoulders, thick arms, big chest and abs, big fluffy dark tail, bare feet with claws, wearing only short dark trunks with a light blue waistband. Compact stocky proportions, about three heads tall, arms relaxed at his sides with fists loosely clenched. Plain flat background, no other characters.
refs: the character seen from behind: body build, fur color, ears with piercings, horns, collar, fluffy tail
the character face and chest from the front: eyes, horns, brow piercings, collar, muscles
the character head in side view: snout shape, fang, eye, horns, cheek fur
